newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open off 0.40 to 0.60 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open off 0.40 to 0.60 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open down 0.40 to 0.60 cent per lb Monday as LME stocks fell, but the London cash to three months backwardation of $73 was barely changed from Friday.
LME stocks fell 2,100 tonnes Monday to 141,575 tonnes.
On ACCESS, COMEX July copper traded 116.00 to 115.90 cents.

Copper ended last week up 4.60 cents at 116.20 cents in most active July contract as LME stocks continued to dwindle sharply and labor concerns hovered over Chilean production. ((New York Commodity Desk 212-859-1646))
